title: August 2026 preliminary controlled results
policy: Negative and null outcomes remain publishable. Excluded runs are retained with their reason but never contribute to effect estimates.

runs.reason: Both controls hit the turn cap, one control was ATIF-invalid after truncation, and the verifier had whitespace sensitivity. Only one pair was analysable.
Both agents inspected repository history, violating the registered source-access rule, and the verifier rejected valid terminology.
The frozen N=1 pair passed its validity, correctness, access, and verifier rules.
Ordinary Cargo execution created Cargo.lock, which the mutation allowlist rejected before the hidden contract tests ran.
The corrected N=1 low-memory pair passed its validity, correctness, mutation, and verifier rules.
The mutation fence rejected Cargo.lock and the required regression test, while two arms also exceeded the requested Claude ceiling.
Both controls crossed the registered ceiling during cold Cargo compilation and exited nonzero, making the validity floor impossible.
The first control produced a correct workspace but exceeded the registered ceiling and exited nonzero, so the run stopped before treatment.
Both N=2 pairs passed the frozen validity, correctness, mutation, mechanism, and budget rules.
The apparent N=1 memory signal did not survive N=5. The marker measured which reasonable interpretation of an ambiguous question the agent chose.
